scope: JavaScript runtime investigation with isolated evidence-only candidates. This agent made no product-file writes.
decision: Retain the currently adopted quick9 JavaScript. Neither candidate met the predeclared primary performance criterion.
selection_rule: At least 4 of 5 pairs faster AND the upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% paired-log Student-t interval below 1. No fixed minimum percentage. Protected bulk ratio bound: 1.03. Cold allowance: max(1 ms, 3%).

screen.scope: One fixed-order Chromium 10k run per variant, shared browser with new contexts. This selected candidates for further work; it does not establish individual gains or permit adding them together.

combined.environment: One browser process per engine; fresh context and page per run.

result.cold_interpretation: Diagnostic interval on paired absolute cold differences. Broad intervals do not prove equivalence; no cold-speed claim is made.

combined.verdict: Not qualified. Runtime and cold uncertainty remain visible. No repeat of this candidate.

horner.environment: Fresh browser process, context and page per run, with the same policy for both variants. Existing combined results are not reclassified.

horner.verdict: All 5 pairs were faster; bulk and cold nonregression criteria passed. The primary ratio interval upper endpoint, 1.012388, is not below 1. Not qualified; the search stopped.

completed_functional_scope: Each timed run compared the same 10,000 fixed input records and 29,278 supplemental words against native f64-bit and per-record consumption references. All 25 screen and qualification runs matched. Repetition does not increase the 10,000 unique-record corpus.
memory: All runs ended with 8 parts / 4,164,157 bytes and 1,270 pages / 4,153,088 bytes. Cache budgets stayed at 4 MiB + 4 MiB. These are payload observations, not total JS heap or RSS bounds. No actual VM allocation reduction has been measured or claimed.
network: All runs observed 99 successful product requests including HTML (module + data: 98), using the unchanged 512 KiB dataset. Byte differences were candidate JS source bytes only. No WAN layout or HTTP-policy change.
not_run_final_candidate_checks: Actual UI 10,000 before/after: conditional on candidate qualification, so not executed.

reused_final_product_evidence.identity_basis: Exact current module, HTML and index byte identity is recorded above. Broader data identity belongs to the root cycle validation; this agent did not rehash all parts after releasing the CPU slot.
